question: Which state government launched the Mahila Samvad campaign aiming to reach 2 crore women for women empowerment?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Bihar government launched the Mahila Samvad campaign to reach 2 crore women across 70,000 locations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Mahila Samvad campaign aims to empower women through various schemes and reach 2 crore women across the state.**
 
• The campaign promotes women's empowerment initiatives, including reservation in Panchayati Raj, government jobs, and self-help groups.
 
• Special mobile vans will be used to spread awareness and collect feedback to improve women-centric programs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Bihar's Efforts in Women’s Empowerment__

 __
 
• The state has been proactive in implementing policies aimed at empowering women, such as reservations and schemes for self-help groups.
 
 
 
• Mahila Samvad Campaign__
 
 
• The campaign is designed to directly engage with women at the grassroots level and address their needs while fostering a participatory approach in policy-making.
